description: Next.js 15 + TailwindCSS demo dashboard for Trinity Guardian (ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026). Tells the product story in 4 screens: agent picker (on-chain payment authority active vs revoked; limits from Guardian policy), seller picker (spam/legit risk legible before paying), payment flow (live 3-layer journey with verdict chips), and the World ID moment (interactive approve/deny on soft-fail — deny is a first-class outcome). Persistent: spend meter vs dailyCap, payment-authority badge, payment log. Agent names are <agent>.agents.trinityguard.eth. Starts from mock fixtures; swaps to real imports as features land on dev. SRS: FR-50..FR-55, FR-60..FR-63.

userStories.title: Dashboard shell and project scaffold
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want a clean dashboard layout so the 4 screens and persistent elements have a home.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 15 + TailwindCSS project at src/ui/ boots with pnpm dev
src/ui/app/page.tsx renders main dashboard layout
Mock fixtures at src/ui/mocks/{agent-events,merchants,agents}.ts match imported type contracts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-50. Can start immediately — mock-first strategy, no dependency on other branches.

userStories.title: Screen 1 — Agent picker with role states
userStories.description: As a demo presenter, I want to pick which agent acts (momo.agents.trinityguard.eth: authority active vs rogue.agents.trinityguard.eth: authority revoked), so selecting a revoked agent visibly changes payment outcomes (kill switch demo).
acceptanceCriteria: AgentPicker lists 2+ agents with name, subname (<agent>.agents.trinityguard.eth), perTxMax, dailyCap
perTxMax and dailyCap come from Guardian policy, not ENS text records
Revoked agent shows red REVOKED payment-authority badge; active shows green ACTIVE
Selecting revoked agent causes later payments to hard-fail at the ENS layer before Intercepta (Act 4)
Uses guardian.readAuthority() and readAppPolicy() when live, mock agents array until then
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-53. Authority is on-chain. Limits are Guardian application state. Not an ENSv2 role named spend.

userStories.title: Screen 2 — Seller picker with spam warning
userStories.description: As a user, I want merchants displayed with spam/scam flags visible BEFORE I commit to paying, so risk is legible upfront.
acceptanceCriteria: SellerPicker lists merchants from GET /merchants (mock until seller lands)
Spam merchant visually distinct: red border/icon/label
Spam reason shown ('Reported rugpull / scam entity') via tooltip or inline
Each merchant card shows name, description, endpoint prices
User can see risk BEFORE clicking buy
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Screen 3 — Payment flow with verdict chips
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want a live feed of the 3-layer journey with green/yellow/red verdicts, so I can watch the trust stack work in real time.
acceptanceCriteria: PaymentFlow renders live PaymentEvent stream from usePaymentEvents hook
LayerCard per layer: ENS gate → Intercepta → caps, each with VerdictChip
VerdictChip: green=pass, yellow=soft_fail, red=hard_fail
Success state: tx hash + 'Settled onchain' badge
Failure state: reason shown prominently
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-50, FR-51. Consumes PaymentEvent from task-agent + GuardianVerdict layers from task-guardian.

userStories.title: Screen 4 — World ID approve/deny panel
userStories.description: As an agent owner, I want an interactive approve/deny panel when soft-fail occurs, so the human moment of the demo is tangible — and deny is a valid outcome, not an error.
acceptanceCriteria: WorldIdPanel appears on approval_requested event
Shows amount, payTo address, escalation reason
Approve button → payment proceeds (single use)
Deny button → payment refused, rendered as a legitimate demo outcome
Mock handler until World sandbox wired
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-54. Wire to guardian.requestApproval() when live.

userStories.title: Persistent elements: spend meter, role badge, payment log
userStories.description: As a viewer, I want ambient state always visible — spend vs cap, agent role, history — so the dashboard feels alive between actions.
acceptanceCriteria: SpendMeter shows $X.XX / $50.00 with progress bar (color shifts at 50%/80%)
RoleBadge shows ACTIVE (green) or REVOKED (red) for the current agent's on-chain payment authority
PaymentLog lists history: timestamp, resource, status, amount
All update live from payment events
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Demo acts walkthrough end-to-end
userStories.description: As a judge, I want to run all 4 demo acts through the UI, so the full story is demonstrable without a terminal.
acceptanceCriteria: Act 1: momo → weather → paid with tx hash
Act 2: momo → data (spam) → Intercepta red → refused with reason
Act 3: momo → compute ($7) → soft-fail → World ID panel → approve or deny both work
Act 4: rogue.agents.trinityguard.eth (authority revoked) → any seller → ENS hard-fail immediately, before Intercepta
All four acts reproducible on demand
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-60..FR-63. Depends on all three backend branches merged to dev for full flow; mock-first before that.
